items.text: Patriots ruled out RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness) for Sunday’s game in Germany against the Lions.
items.opportunity: More work for Rhamondre Stevenson if healthy

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay said the team will not place Puka Nacua on IR due to roster mechanics, but the WR will still be out for a significant period of time (optimistic return Week 14/15).
items.why: Roster mechanics; PCL/MCL sprains + turf toe
items.implication: Multi-week absence; Rams pass game depleted
items.opportunity: Increased run lean, targets to remaining WRs/TEs

items.text: Josh Jacobs will undergo finger surgery and could miss 2-3 weeks; IR not guaranteed, decision Saturday; out Week 10 vs Vikings (bye Week 11).
items.why: Broken right ring finger; no grip strength
items.implication: Out at least W10; stashable with short timeline possible
items.opportunity: Short-term volume to MarShawn Lloyd/Kaleb Johnson/Chris Brooks

items.text: There are scenarios where Davante Adams (hamstring) plays and Puka Nacua (knee, toe) doesn't for some of fantasy's most important weeks; discussed on ROS rankings show.
items.why: Adams hamstring timeline vs Nacua multi-week knee/toe
items.implication: Adams could be available for key stretch while Nacua sits
items.opportunity: Adams as higher-upside WR if timeline hits; Rams WR scarcity

items.text: Chiefs listed QB Patrick Mahomes as a full participant in today’s practice, putting him on track to play Sunday at Atlanta.
items.opportunity: Full Mahomes usage for KC weapons

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo (hamstring) and QB JJ McCarthy (hip) have no injury status designation for Thursday night and are good to go vs. the Commanders.
items.implication: Expected to play and contribute in backfield

items.text: Vikings were positive PROE despite bad QB play; could see pass rate spike with Kirk Cousins as Kevin O'Connell wants to throw.
items.why: Positive PROE already; Cousins upgrade + OC preference
items.implication: Higher pass volume boosts Jefferson and MIN pass-catchers

items.text: Expecting Rams to lean more negative PROE (run-oriented) while playing without both Puka Nacua and Davante Adams; No. 9 OL helps.
items.implication: Lower pass volume; more RB work

items.text: I said the Vikings should bring Kirk Cousins back. If you roster Justin Jefferson, you get why. Across 54 games with Cousins, Jefferson averaged 19.6 PPR; LOVE that.
items.why: Historical 19.6 PPR avg with Cousins; trade confirms

items.text: Jordyn Tyson's time is coming, but it's not this week. I am CLOSING IT OUT on Tyson in week 10.
items.why: Not ready this week despite future upside

items.text: I am KEEPING IT OPEN on Jadarian Price, even with Charb back.
items.why: Role opportunity persists despite Charbs return
items.implication: Viable flex/RB depth with committee upside

items.text: When you have a healthy Joe Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins... this is what you do. Let them cook (high PROE).
items.why: Healthy trio drives high pass rate over expectation
items.opportunity: Elite target share and scoring for Chase/Higgins

items.text: Worried about Brock Bowers with Fernando Mendoza at QB? Bowers put up monster numbers as a rookie with O’Connell, Minshew and Ridder. I think he’ll be just fine.
items.why: Proven production with multiple QBs as rookie
items.implication: No major downgrade expected from QB change

items.text: Need a WR off the waiver wire? Pop Douglas is still available in 54% of leagues. He’s had an 80% route share over his last two games. I’d pick him up, and I’m fine starting him in a pinch against Detroit.
items.why: 80% route share last two games; available widely
items.implication: High-upside waiver add and potential start
